description: This header file defines an interface class 'IPluginStarter' for managing plugin activation within a software system, specifically for starting Thunder plugins with retry logic.

classes.name: IPluginStarter
classes.description: An interface for starting a specified plugin, with a method to activate a plugin with retries.

methods.name: activatePlugin
methods.description: Activates a Thunder plugin, retrying up to maxRetries times with a delay specified by retryDelayMs.
